normative_extracts.quote: Events propagate through the event path in capturing, target, and bubbling phases.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Static construction of the event path prior to listener execution.

production_failures.symptom: Blocked scroll / mobile jank with touchstart listener
production_failures.root_cause: Listener not marked { passive: true }, forcing the Compositor to wait on the main thread.
production_failures.mitigation: Pass { passive: true } on wheel/touchstart listeners that do not call preventDefault().

production_failures.symptom: Popover menus fail to dismiss on internal clicks
production_failures.root_cause: Calling e.stopPropagation() inside a child button.
production_failures.mitigation: Avoid stopPropagation() and filter via e.target.closest().
